description_en: Modifies the name and description of an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
description_zh: 修改共享带宽实例的名称和描述信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-common-bandwidth-package-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-2ze2ic1xd2qeqk1450000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCommonBandwidthPackageAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance is located. 

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
共享带宽所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
共享带宽的名称。 
长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
共享带宽的描述信息。  
长度为0-256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description
